description: Defines a Model class for managing todo items, including create, read, update, delete, and count functionalities, and exports it to the global window object.

classes.name: Model
classes.description: A class for managing todo items with CRUD operations and counting functionality.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new todo item with a title and saves it using storage.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves todo items based on query: all, by ID, or matching an object.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a todo item identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a todo item by ID.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all todo items from storage.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Counts active, completed, and total todos.
